entity: New York State Department of Transportation
stance_basis: paraphrased opinion on availability of relocation sites, neither supporting nor opposing the project
summary: The New York State Department of Transportation is cited in a narrator paraphrase for the opinion of its relocation specialists, who assessed that sufficient vacant industrially-zoned parcels exist within the City of Buffalo to accommodate all businesses displaced by the South Yard that wish to remain in Buffalo. The agency does not express a broader position on the project itself, and its mention is limited to a technical assessment of relocation feasibility.
complaint_summary: Relocation specialists at the New York State Department of Transportation opined that there are enough vacant industrially-zoned parcels within the City of Buffalo to accommodate all businesses displaced by the South Yard that wish to remain in Buffalo.
summary_quote: However, in the opinion of relocation specialists at the New York State Department of Transportation, there are enough vacant industrially-zoned parcels within the City to accommodate all of these businesses that wish to remain in Buffalo.
